newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil aluminium output 1.3 percent up in April.
newsitem.headline: Brazil aluminium output 1.3 percent up in April.

text.p: Brazilian production of primary aluminium totalled 99,000 tonnes in April, said Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL) in a statement.
This was only 1.3 percent higher than the 97,700 tonnes produced in April 1996 and similar to the 101,100 tonnes produced in March this year, it added.
Production in the first four months of this year reached 391,300 tonnes, a slight fall of one percent on the 395,100 tonnes produced in January/April 1996.
With a few variations, this pattern should continue throughout 1997 given there are no plans to expand production, ABAL said. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
